Salford’s Andi Jones was at the front with favourite Tom Humphries a step behind and then Steve Vernon (Stockport), Mike Skinner (Blackheath & Bromley), Phil Wicks and Matt Watson of Bingley, all bouncing off each other in their efforts to keep close to the leaders; and then came the climb!
In the 9.5k Senior Men’s race first Brit home with a fine run was Phil Wicks in 8th spot, ahead of compatriots Bowser, Humphries and McLeod.
